text: How was the first night?? Did he sleep or did you not sleep jaja
Ugh. He cried from 2 to 4. I sat on the floor next to the box like an idiot
He did sleep after that tho. Then woke up at 6:40 and wanted to go out immediately
Jaja pobre. 6:40 is the real problem
Did you take him down or did you use the pad
Down. With a coat over the pajamas. The lady from 3B saw me
Jaja the coat
Xq it was 6 am and it was raining
Ok that's fair
Did you get any sleep today or are you dead at the counter
Nap in the afternoon for 40 min. I'm home now, he's asleep on my feet. I think he's asleep
Send pic
Not moving my foot to take a photo. He has the whole leg
Jaja hostage situation. Name him so I can send condolences
Tito
Still not moving

note: 00:40-07:00 Lucía asleep, Tito on her feet

text: He's up. 6:40 again. I'm already in the coat

Pic. He's asleep in the box with one ear out
Ahhh
Ok the ear is the killer

text: Back. Did the walk. He peed on the neighbour's plant and I wanted to die

text: He's up. 6:55 today, so that's progress

Obviously. Bring the slipper too, I want evidence

Not sure. Don't trust me, check
Googling. Says mild stomach stuff but also "toxic" in some places and I can't tell which is which
Call the vet line tomorrow if he's throwing up or acting weird. Don't trust google jaja
